verdict.rationale: The official iOS App Store listing shows a capable mobile app with photo upload and transcription, real-time Advanced Voice Mode, image generation, and sticker creation. The docs also say ChatGPT Work tasks can continue on the web, iOS, or Android, which confirms an official Android client. Missing for 10: any direct documentation of the Android app's feature set, evidence of mobile parity with desktop-only features such as Computer Use, Goal mode and desktop voice task coordination, and independent or hands-on reports on the mobile apps.
